newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guoco makes offer for Lap Heng.
newsitem.headline: Guoco makes offer for Lap Heng.

text.p: Guoco Group Ltd said it will make a general offer of HK$10.177 per share for Lap Heng Co Ltd after buying out the controlling shareholders of the company and subscribing to new shares.

Guoco said it had agreed to buy from Lap Heng's controlling shareholders their entire stake of 27.49 million shares, or 48.8 percent of Lap Heng's existing share capital, at HK$10.177 per share, for a total HK$279.81 million.
Guoco has also agreed to subscribe to 45 million new Lap Heng shares, or 44.4 percent of Lap Heng's enlarged share capital, at HK$8.00 per share, it said.
After the two transactions it would own 72.49 million shares, or 71.6 percent of Lap Heng, and would be required to make a general offer for all outstanding shares of the company.
Guoco said it would make a general offer at HK$10.177 per share on completion on January 15, 1997, of the above transactions.
Meanwhile, Lap Heng will buy properties for HK$827 million from Guoco.
Guoco intends to change Lap Heng's name to Guoco Land Ltd. The company will engage in property investment and development and its property portfolio will amount to HK$836 million, Guoco said.
Trading in Lap Heng shares will resume on the business day immediately following the completion of the deal in January.
